items.name: Storekeeper's Key-Ring
items.lore: Every lock in Ardagh's stores. Most of them still work.

items.name: Rat-Catcher's Bracer
items.lore: Scratched to ribbons. The rats lost.

items.name: Lookout's Signal Mirror
items.lore: A scrap of polished silver the lookout used to flash signals. You can see your own nose in it.

items.name: Sentinel-Post Belt
items.lore: Issue gear from the sentinel post. Ailbe's spare.

items.name: Lunch-Tin Charm
items.lore: A miner's lunch-tin lid, dented by a badger's teeth. It still smells faintly of cheese.

items.name: Stinky's Collar Ring
items.lore: Stinky's own collar, cut down. Somebody once loved that badger. Probably.

items.name: Badger-Brush Sash
items.lore: Made from Stinky's shed fur. It does not smell of roses.

items.name: Creeping-Pebble Charm
items.lore: A pebble that inched across your palm while you weren't looking.

items.name: Field-Wall Bracer
items.lore: Dry-stone walling, the farmers' way. Not one stone moved.

items.name: Stone-Song Torc
items.lore: Seireadan's voice, caught in a ring of granite. It hums when the stones move.

items.name: Singer's Pebble Ring
items.lore: Polished smooth by a hundred years of singing.

items.name: Ogham-Stick Charm
items.lore: A stick notched with ogham. It reads 'wake', and then, newly carved beneath, 'sleep'.

items.name: Mason's Plumb-Ring
items.lore: A mason's plumb-bob, worn as a ring. It always hangs true.

items.name: Walking-Stone Belt
items.lore: Pebbles shed by a walking stone, strung on leather. They shift a little at night.

items.name: Lough-Water Cloak
items.lore: Damp, always, but never cold.

items.name: Moon-Silver Sliver Pendant
items.lore: The first sliver of moon-silver anyone in Ardagh ever held. It's cold, and it hums, and you can't stop looking at it.

items.name: Ring-Warden's Shard Bracer
items.lore: A shard of the ring-stone, bound in leather. It's still a little warm.

items.name: Rowan-Bound Belt
items.lore: Muirne's work: rowan bark woven tight. 'Keeps the singing out of your head.'

items.name: Howth-Stamped Pick Charm
items.lore: A pick-head stamped HOWTH, shrunk to a charm. Maeve counted it back in.

items.name: Tool-Cache Belt
items.lore: Every loop holds a tool. The spraggons had good taste in belts.

items.name: Tinker's Ledger-Strap Bracer
items.lore: The tinker kept his ledger strapped to his arm. You keep your arm.

items.name: Brass-Gear Ring
items.lore: A tiny gear from a spraggon contraption. It turns, very slowly, by itself.

items.name: Crown-of-Nails Torc
items.lore: Boss's crown, beaten flat into a torc. Fewer nails sticking out now. Mostly.

items.name: Boss's Pocket-Watch Charm
items.lore: Stolen from a Howth merchant ten years ago. It's never once told the right time.

items.name: Sargoth's Tusk Ring
items.lore: A tusk off the biggest spraggon anyone's seen. Polished, it's almost pretty.

items.name: Den-Lord's Mantle
items.lore: Patched from a dozen stolen sacks. Warmer than it looks.

items.name: Howth Miners' Token
items.lore: Every miner in Howth chipped in for it. It says 'thank you' in very bad lettering.

items.name: Silver-Tipped Arrow Charm
items.lore: An arrowhead of pale silver. The sheevra archers have the best arrows in Hibernia now.

items.name: Spoil-Heap Bracer
items.lore: Dust-grey leather off a sheevra archer. It's been shot at, a lot.

items.name: Silver-Vein Ring
items.lore: Silvermine silver, raw and bright, from a vein no Hibernian has seen in a hundred years.

items.name: Miner's Pick-Bracer
items.lore: A pick's head, flattened and bent into a bracer.

items.name: Deep-Lamp Pendant
items.lore: A tiny lamp that glows faintly underground.

items.name: Sheevra Chief's Belt
items.lore: Studded with silver nails pulled from the Silvermine rock.

items.name: Scar-Nose's Silver Collar
items.lore: A war-badger's collar, sheevra silver. It was made for a neck much thicker than yours.

items.name: Badger-Hide Bracer
items.lore: Thick, scarred and nearly arrow-proof.

items.name: Overseer's Whip-Handle Charm
items.lore: Camlin's whip, the lash cut off. The handle's all that's left. That's enough.

items.name: Tally-Keeper's Belt
items.lore: Camlin kept his tallies on a belt of notched leather. Every notch a cartload.

items.name: Freed-Miner's Bracer
items.lore: The miners Camlin worked gave it to you. They made it from his chains.

items.name: Dergal's Silver Torc
items.lore: The war-chief's torc, sheevra silver. Ardagh's smiths say it's the finest they've seen.

items.name: Mine-Warden's Mantle
items.lore: Grey with a silver pick. The Wardens give these to their own.

items.name: Lake-Camp Banner Ring
items.lore: A ring cut from the sheevra lake camp's banner-pole.

items.name: Ardagh's Thanks
items.lore: Every miner in Ardagh put a coin in for it. It's mostly coins.

items.name: Miner's Tally-Stick Charm
items.lore: Forty-one notches, one for every miner. Ethna carved a forty-second for you.

items.name: Cold-Light Bracer
items.lore: It glows faintly blue at night, like the camp.

items.name: Seal-Stone Fragment Ring
items.lore: A chip of the druids' seal. Ogham runs round it: 'shut'.

items.name: Bone-Dust Pouch Belt
items.lore: The miners' bones, gathered and buried. You kept the pouch you carried them in.

items.name: Deamhan-Stone Bracer
items.lore: Hacked off a deamhan creig. It's still angry.

items.name: Storm-Glass Pendant
items.lore: Lightning, caught in glass when a mephit died. It crackles.

items.name: Heights Wanderer's Cloak
items.lore: Grey and heavy, for the sleet. You'll want it up there.

items.name: Vein-Heart Torc
items.lore: Moon-silver from the Thing's own heart, quieted. Ethna blessed it. It sings softly now, a lullaby.

items.name: Deep-Seal Ring
items.lore: Carved from the new seal-stone, ogham and all: 'sleep'.

items.name: Thing-Slayer's Bracer
items.lore: Stone from the Thing's hide. Nothing in the valley will touch you while you wear it. Nothing alive.

items.name: Forty-One Names Cloak
items.lore: Embroidered with the names of the miners of the Fallen Camp. Ethna stitched every one.

items.name: Moon-Dust Satchel Belt
items.lore: A druid's satchel. The moon-silver dust in its seams still glitters.

items.name: Turned Druid's Ring
items.lore: A Rowan ring, its berries scraped off. Muirne wept when she saw it.

items.name: Hermit's Hazel Staff-Charm
items.lore: A knot of Nictol's staff. It was a good staff once.

items.name: Unkempt Mantle
items.lore: Nictol's cloak, cleaned. Three times. It's still not entirely clean.

items.name: Broker's Ledger Case
items.lore: The Broker's accounts. Every cart to Connacht, every bead paid. The Rowan sent a copy to Ardee.

items.name: Blue-Bead Breaker Ring
items.lore: A ring of crushed blue beads, set in silver. The Azure Order's coin, made worthless.

items.name: Rowan-and-Silver Torc
items.lore: Moon-silver, quieted, woven with rowan. Muirne's own making.
